name: ImageJ
summary_zh: 原始 ImageJ（ImageJ 1.x）官方下載頁。可用於顯微影像處理、面積與顆粒分析、灰階定量及 ROI 量測；請依作業系統選擇合適安裝版本。
summary_en: Official original ImageJ (1.x) downloads for microscopy image processing, ROI measurements, particle analysis and densitometry. Choose the package for your operating system.
license_zh: ImageJ 原始程式屬公有領域（Public Domain）；另行安裝的外掛、套件或其他發行版可能有不同授權。請查閱來源說明及個別授權。
license_en: Original ImageJ is public-domain software. Third-party plugins and other distributions may have different licenses; verify their individual terms.
action_zh: 前往 ImageJ 官方下載

name: SOLIDWORKS for Students
summary_zh: 前往 SOLIDWORKS 官方學生方案，申請／下載 Design Standard for Students；官方另提供付費進階學生方案。適合零件、組合件與工程圖設計。
summary_en: Visit the official student program for access to SOLIDWORKS Design Standard for Students, with optional paid advanced student editions. Designed for parts, assemblies and drawings.
license_zh: 免費 Design Standard 僅供符合資格的個別學生申請；學生授權限個人學習，並非學校教室或實驗室授權，亦不得直接視為商業／產學用途許可。以官方當期條款及所在地適用方案為準。
license_en: Free Design Standard is for eligible individual students; a student license is not a school lab/classroom license and does not confer commercial-use rights. Follow current official terms and regional eligibility.
action_zh: 前往 SOLIDWORKS 學生申請

name: Autodesk Fusion for Education
platform_zh: Windows · macOS · 需教育資格驗證
summary_zh: 前往 Autodesk Fusion 官方教育申請頁。適用於 3D 建模、微流體元件設計及 CNC／3D 列印製造流程；符合資格的學生及教職員可申請教育存取權限。
summary_en: Official Autodesk Fusion educational access for 3D design, microfluidic components, CNC and additive-manufacturing workflows. Eligibility verification is required.
license_zh: 教育授權須符合學生／教職員資格與驗證要求；原則上提供一年免費教育存取並可依資格續期。僅限官方允許的教育用途，不得用於商業、專業或營利用途。
license_en: Educational access requires verified eligibility, is generally renewable annually, and is limited to permitted educational purposes—not commercial, professional or for-profit work.
action_zh: 前往 Fusion 教育版申請
